description: This file implements RFC2831 DIGEST-MD5 and RFC7616 DIGEST-SHA256/512-256 authentication for the cURL library. It contains functions to parse, decode, create, and manage digest authentication messages, handle nonce and realm management, and support different hashing algorithms. The file defines classes, methods, and constants specific to digest authentication within the cURL project.

methods.name: bool Curl_auth_digest_get_pair(const char * str,char * value,char * content,const char ** endptr)
methods.description: Parses a key-value pair from a digest challenge string, handling optional quoting and escaping.

methods.name: void auth_digest_md5_to_ascii(unsigned char * source,unsigned char * dest)
methods.description: Converts a 16-byte MD5 hash to RFC2617 hex string.

methods.name: void auth_digest_sha256_to_ascii(unsigned char * source,unsigned char * dest)
methods.description: Converts a 32-byte SHA-256 or SHA-512/256 hash to hex string.

methods.name: char * auth_digest_string_quoted(const char * source)
methods.description: Encloses a string in quotes and escapes necessary characters.

methods.name: bool auth_digest_get_key_value(const char * chlg,const char * key,char * value,size_t max_val_len,char end_char)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific key's value from a challenge string.

methods.name: CURLcode auth_digest_get_qop_values(const char * options,int * value)
methods.description: Parses the qop options string and sets corresponding flags.

methods.name: CURLcode auth_decode_digest_md5_message(const struct bufref * chlgref,char * nonce,size_t nlen,char * realm,size_t rlen,char * alg,size_t alen,char * qop,size_t qlen)
methods.description: Decodes a Digest-MD5 challenge message into its components.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_digest_md5_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const struct bufref * chlg,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,const char * service,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates a digest response message based on the challenge and credentials.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_decode_digest_http_message(const char * chlg,struct digestdata * digest)
methods.description: Parses an HTTP digest challenge message into its parts.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_digest_http_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,const unsigned char * request,const unsigned char * uripath,struct digestdata * digest,char ** outptr,size_t * outlen)
methods.description: Creates an HTTP digest response header, supporting different hash algorithms.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_digest_cleanup(struct digestdata * digest)
methods.description: Frees and resets digest-specific data fields.
